scope: CPU-only design-space discrimination; exactly one center rule, two snapshots and 64 original queries; no update, hierarchy, CUDA or timing
partition: Frozen S1/P2; 4096 strict-median leaves of 244/245 objects; not the 4167-block slack initialization

center_rule.name: C0 Signature-Medoid Center
center_rule.signature: sqrt(first four ordered-FP64 S1 pivot scores), fixed from prior proof; no queries, radius or oracle
center_rule.mean: FP64 left-to-right accumulation in frozen block-member order separately in each of four dimensions, divide by block size
center_rule.score: Squared distance to signature mean: subtract/multiply FP64, add terms in pivot dimension order 0..3, no reassociation or contraction
center_rule.selection: Min score, exact FP64 ties choose smallest immutable occurrence ID; one member center per block. This is nearest-to-signature-mean, not exact original-space medoid optimization.

numerics: Ordered FP64 full-D subtraction/product/sum; no fast math/FMA. Prior envelope e=(4D+16)*2^-52. Cover radius=max(member norm upper endpoints); reject only query-center lower > nextup(R_B+r_upper); equality retained.
aggregate: All original 32 queries per snapshot, arithmetic mean; quantiles NumPy linear method; no averaging across snapshots for gates

gates.GO_LOCAL: Zero false prune; BOTH snapshots mean<=0.50 and p90<=0.70
gates.STRONG_GO_LOCAL: Must first satisfy GO_LOCAL, then BOTH means<=0.35; final label remains GO_LOCAL
gates.CONDITIONAL_SUPPORTED: No GO or NO-GO; both means<=0.65, at least one >0.50, and each snapshot improves GLOBAL4 by >=0.15 absolute fraction (15 percentage points)
gates.NO_GO_LOCAL_BALL: On at least one SAME snapshot, local mean>0.65 AND global4_mean-local_mean<0.10 (10 percentage points)
gates.UNCOVERED: CONDITIONAL_LOCAL with reason=uncovered_interval; not a positive conditional-band pass. No automatic next family, update, hierarchy or CUDA experiment.
gates.correctness: Any false prune, invalid input or provenance mismatch stops immediately before structural decision.

cost_proxy.GLOBAL4: 4 full-D query-pivot distances; 8 FP64 endpoints/block (262144 bytes for 4096); pivot coordinate payload=4*D*4. Optional pivot IDs reported separately.
cost_proxy.LOCAL_BALL: 4096 full-D query-center distances; one FP64 radius/block=32768 bytes. Separate optional 64-bit center IDs=32768 bytes; packed center coordinate payload=4096*D*4=15728640 bytes. No center-distance reuse or conditional hierarchy assumed.
cost_proxy.FULL_SCAN: N full-D distances; coordinate payload=N*D*4=3840000000 bytes; no summary required.
cost_proxy.remaining_verification: For each candidate summary, report surviving live objects and modeled total distance evaluations = summary distances + surviving objects. No executed verifier, coordinate reuse, caching, or measured transactions claimed.
cost_proxy.bytes: Decimal MB/GB and exact bytes. Coordinate bytes exclude query coordinates/cache behavior unless separately named. Not measured traffic or time.

novelty_gate.status: No novelty claim; bounded diagnostic of established ball filtering
novelty_gate.nearest_prior_art: M-tree: An Efficient Access Method for Similarity Search in Metric Spaces (VLDB 1997), covering radius and triangle-inequality range pruning
novelty_gate.boundary: Do not promote classic local ball ported to GPU as novel; future co-design requires separate prior-art and same-contract end-to-end gates.
